subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'EXAM' is written as '625214' and 'TEST' is written as '2162021'. How will 'ASSESSMENT' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1) is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'EXAM' is written as '625214'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4857dd6f062be4633a9f726899cbca0db342569529bdb2b7546bf9d514dc6858.png] 

And,

 
• TEST' is written as '2162021'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d565ef4a092fbfedf451202b795aca68dbd219bb7dfbd4f53f2eb477bbd8fcc6.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'ASSESSMENT' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f31648e3d786b4a126270f34879159c138d638d022e481c4925f99e1560f186.png] 

​Hence, "**22020620201461521**" is the correct answer.

3f
